prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE photographic foreground asset for a realistic freshwater aquarium website, PORTRAIT 1024x1536 composition, genuine transparent RGBA background. Broad elongated fern leaves mixed with delicate fine fronds, natural overlapping leaf gaps, no detached leaves or cut dangling roots in midair. Viewpoint is a near-frontal three-quarter underwater view, believable botanical scale. Real photographic texture, translucent natural fern green, soft diffused daylight from upper-left filtered through water, mildly cool cyan-green ambient light, soft attached shadows at leaf/stem/wood junctions. No studio white lighting, no hyper-polished plastic. All space around unit AND between leaves must be ACTUAL alpha transparency, no rectangular water, no fog halo, no checkerboard, no added background. No sand carpet or floor in this asset, no fish, shrimp, equipment, text, watermark or border. The subject must read as plants rooted onto wood/stone resting on an aquarium floor; every stem visibly traces into a coherent attached base. Do not crop off the base.
attachment: Every fern/Anubias stem continues into a rooted rhizome mounted on whole driftwood and stone. Base must physically meet scene floor.
note: Illustrative photographic asset; not a product SKU. Physical floor/wall attachment must be maintained in scene geometry.
